detail: Chetan Shah has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to the NSE for Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of acquisitions of shares and voting rights in listed companies when prescribed thresholds are crossed. The filing signals a substantial change in shareholding or control and triggers the mandatory disclosure and potential open-offer obligations under the SEBI takeover code.
